City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 16, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Environmental Commission Recommendations on Community Choice Aggregation (CCA). Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1. Receive a report from the Environmental Commission titled "Summary & Recommendations for Encinitas Regarding CCAs." 2. Provide direction to the City Manager.
2015-12-16 Item 10A Community Choice Aggregation (CCA)
10B.
Appointment of Council Members to City and Regional Committees and Boards. Contact Person: Management Analyst McSeveney
Discuss the Mayor's recommended appointments to City and regional committees and boards for 2016 and approve final appointments.
2015-12-16 Item 10B Appointment of Council Members to Regional Boards and Commissions
2015-12-16 Item 10B Attachment 3 to the Agenda Report
10C.
Report on Medical Marijuana Regulation and Safety Act (AB 266, AB 243 and SB 643) - Impact on Local Control of Medical Marijuana Related Activities; and, the consideration and possible adoption of the following ordinances:
1)
ORDINANCE No. 2015-19 entitled "AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ENCINITAS RE-AFFIRMING AND CONFIRMING THAT THE CULTIVATION OF MARIJUANA AND ANY RELATED USES IS PROHIBITED PURSUANT TO THE PERMISSIVE ZONING CODE ENACTED IN THE ENCINITAS MUNICIPAL CODE; AND, THEREFORE, THE STATE IS PROHIBITED FROM ISSUING A LICENSE FOR THE CULTIVATION OF MEDICAL MARIJUANA AND ANY RELATED USES IN THE CITY OF ENCINITAS; and
2)
ORDINANCE No. 2015-20 entitled "AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ENCINITAS ADDING CHAPTER 9.46 TO THE CITY OF ENCINITAS MUNICIPAL CODE FOR THE PURPOSE OF EXPRESSLY PROHIBITING MOBILE DISPENSING AND DELIVERY OF MARIJUANA." Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
Council consider the options identified in the report and independently consider (i.e., separate motions) the possibility of the introduction of Ordinance No. 2015-19 and Ordinance No. 2015-20.
2015-12-16 Item 10C Medical Marijuana Regulations
10D.
Presentation of City of Encinitas Solar Assessment Report. Contact Person: Public Works Director Pruim
1. Receive City of Encinitas Solar Assessment Report, prepared by 3fficient. 2. Provide staff with direction.
2015-12-16 Item 10D Solar Assessment Report
10E.
Conversations in the Community to Promote General Civic Engagement in Encinitas. Contact Person: Senior Planner Strong
1. Consider the information in the Agenda Report; 2. Receive and consider public testimony; and 3. Provide direction to staff as appropriate.
2015-12-16 Item 10E Community Conversations
10F.
Report back on the results of the Interim Provisions of the Affordable Unit Policy (AUP) program and consideration of possible options to amend the AUP program and/or continue the Interim AUP program provisions in an effort to incentivize participation. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1. Discuss the results of the Interim Provisions of the AUP program; 2. Consider available options regarding the AUP program; and 3. Provide staff direction.
2015-12-16 Item 10F Affordable Unit Policy Report Back
10G.
Award of a Professional Services Contract for the development of the Comprehensive Parking Study. Contact Person: Deputy Director Deane
1. Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract with Chen Ryan Associates, Inc. in the amount of $104,080 plus 10% contingencies to develop the Comprehensive Parking Study, for a not to exceed total project allocation of $114,488 (the Agreement in Substantial Form contained in Attachment 4). 2. Adopt Resolution 2015-87, authorizing the appropriation of general funds in the amount of $64,488 to the Comprehensive Parking Study (WC15C) (Attachment 1).
2015-12-16 Item 10G Comprehensive Parking Study Contract
10H.
Presentation of the City's Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2015. Contact Person: Finance Manager Choquette
City Council accept and file the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2015 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report.
2015-12-16 Item 10H CAFR for year ended 6-30-15
10I.
Consideration of Resolution 2015-86 Approving the Adoption of the amended Citywide Records Retention Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2015-86 approving the amended Citywide Records Retention Schedule.
2015-12-16 Item 10I Records Retention Schedule
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-12-16 Item 8A Warrants
8B.
Carlsbad Watershed Management Area Cost Sharing Agreement and Consultant Services contract. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1.
Authorize the Public Works Director to execute the agreement titled "Agreement to Share Cost of Carlsbad Watershed Management Area Monitoring and Assessment Requirements" and any necessary extensions, between the City of Encinitas and the County of San Diego, the City of Carlsbad, the City of Escondido, the City of San Marcos, the City of Oceanside, the City of Solana Beach, and the City of Vista (collectively, "Parties" and individually, "Party"), to establish the responsibilities of each Party with respect to compliance with San Diego Regional Water Quality Control Board Order R9-2013-0001.
2.
Authorize the Public Works Director, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a three-year contract, and any necessary extensions, with Amec Foster Wheeler Environment & Infrastructure, Inc., in the amount of $420,348, plus $63,052 (15% share of contract total) for a total contract award not to exceed $483,400, to provide Carlsbad Watershed Management Area monitoring and data assessment.
3.
Adopt Resolution 2015-76, authorizing the appropriation of funds to be received from the Parties in the amount of $435,218 to the TMDL Compliance Program (WB11A) (Attachment 1) and authorizing the receipt of $21,761 ($18,922 plus $2,839 (15% contingency)) from the Parties for services provided to the Project (WB11A).
2015-12-16 Item 8B CWMA Cost Share & Professional Services Agreement
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10F.
Report back on the results of the Interim Provisions of the Affordable Unit Policy (AUP) program and consideration of possible options to amend the AUP program and/or continue the Interim AUP program provisions in an effort to incentivize participation. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1. Discuss the results of the Interim Provisions of the AUP program; 2. Consider available options regarding the AUP program; and 3. Provide staff direction.
10I.
Consideration of Resolution 2015-86 Approving the Adoption of the amended Citywide Records Retention Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2015-86 approving the amended Citywide Records Retention Schedule.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Initiated Item from Council Member Kranz regarding consideration of joining the "Building Welcoming Communities Campaign."
2015-12-16 Item 12A Council Initiated Item from Council Member Kranz
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-12-16 Item 15 City Council Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
THE DECEMBER 23, 2015 REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING IS CANCELLED.
THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 13, 2016.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
